primary.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services - Part 1: Safety requirements
primary.summary: IS 16102 (Part 1) specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps with integral means for stable operation, for domestic and similar general lighting, rated 1 W to 60 W, rated voltage above 50 V up to 250 V at 50 Hz, with E14, E27, B22d and B15d caps. It covers marking, protection against electric shock, insulation resistance and electric strength, mechanical strength, cap temperature rise, resistance to heat and fire, and fault conditions.

sources.doc: BIS - Indian Standards on LED (LED series list)

related.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services - Part 2: Performance requirements
related.relation: Performance companion standard (lumen output, efficacy, colour, life) - tested for BIS registration alongside Part 1.

related.title: Safety of lamp control gear - Particular requirements for d.c. or a.c. supplied electronic control gear for LED modules
related.relation: Applies where a separate LED driver/module is used.

certification.summary: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting are notified for compulsory registration. The manufacturer must obtain a BIS Registration Number under the Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) and mark the lamp with the Standard Mark for CRS (self-declaration of conformity) before it is manufactured, imported or sold in India.

qco.title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order - LED lamps / general lighting notified for compulsory registration
qco.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
qco.notified: LED lamps added to the CRS notified list by MeitY
qco.enforced: As per the MeitY notification dates for the LED lamp category

sources.doc: Annexure - List of consumer products notified for compulsory marking

applicable.name: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
applicable.covers: Registration of the model with BIS on the basis of a test report from a BIS-recognised laboratory against IS 16102 (Part 1). The manufacturer then self-declares conformity and uses the Standard Mark with the BIS registration number.
applicable.why: LED lamps for general lighting are an electronics/IT good notified by MeitY under CRS; CRS uses registration and lab testing, not a full factory ISI-mark licence.
applicable.you_receive: A BIS Registration Number for each registered model and the right to apply the CRS Standard Mark; registration is normally valid for 2 years and renewable.

not_applicable.name: Scheme I (ISI Mark Scheme)
not_applicable.why: Scheme I with a factory Scheme of Inspection and Testing is not used for CRS-notified electronics; LED lamps are covered by registration under Scheme II.

not_applicable.name: Scheme X
not_applicable.why: Scheme X applies to specified machinery/equipment to a purchaser's specification, not to general-lighting LED lamps.

testing.summary: One sample per model (and per manufacturing location) is tested at a BIS-recognised CRS laboratory against IS 16102 (Part 1). The test report is uploaded with the registration application.

tests.name: Marking and interchangeability of the cap
Protection against electric shock / accessibility of live parts
Resistance to heat and to flame and ignition

sources.doc: Uniform Test Report Formats for CRS - BIS

labs.note: CRS testing must be at a BIS-recognised laboratory with IS 16102 (Part 1) in its CRS scope. Check the recognised-labs list for the LED lamp product category.

entries.name: Bureau Veritas / TUV / SGS empanelled CRS labs
entries.scope: Confirm IS 16102 Part 1 CRS scope per location

licensing.summary: CRS registration for an LED lamp model is applied for online on the BIS CRS portal: get the model tested at a recognised lab -> file the registration application with the test report and firm documents -> BIS scrutiny -> grant of the BIS Registration Number. No routine BIS factory inspection is done for CRS, but BIS carries out market surveillance.

steps.title: Get the model tested
steps.detail: Send one sample per model (and per factory) to a BIS-recognised CRS laboratory for testing against IS 16102 (Part 1); obtain the test report in the prescribed format.
steps.timeline: Lab-queue dependent; typically a few weeks

steps.title: File the registration application online
steps.detail: On the BIS CRS portal (crsbis.in), create the manufacturer account, enter model details, upload the test report, firm documents and (for importers) the AIR papers, and pay the fee.

steps.title: Scrutiny by BIS
steps.detail: BIS scrutinises the application and test report; raises queries if any information is missing.
steps.timeline: About 15-20 working days for a complete application

steps.title: Grant of the BIS Registration Number
steps.detail: BIS grants a registration number for the model; the manufacturer may then self-declare conformity and apply the CRS Standard Mark with the registration number.
steps.timeline: Commonly around 3-4 weeks from a clean application

steps.title: Maintain and renew
steps.detail: Keep records and continue conformance; registration is valid for 2 years and is renewable. BIS conducts market surveillance sampling.

documents.summary: Documents for the CRS registration application for an LED lamp model. Conditional items depend on the firm and whether the applicant is an importer.

items.name: Test report against IS 16102 (Part 1) in the prescribed format
items.explanation: From a BIS-recognised CRS laboratory, per model and per manufacturing location. This is the core of the application.

sources.doc: Uniform Test Report Formats for CRS

items.name: Firm / factory registration proof
items.explanation: Business registration, GST, factory licence or Udyam registration and factory address proof.

items.name: Trademark / brand certificate or authorisation
items.explanation: Registration or ownership proof for the brand under which the lamp is sold, or a brand-use authorisation.

items.name: Authorised signatory authorisation and ID proof
items.explanation: Board resolution or authorisation letter plus ID of the person signing.

items.name: Details / photographs / marking layout of the model
items.explanation: Model name, wattage, cap type, rating plate and proposed Standard Mark placement.

items.name: Bill of materials / critical components list
items.explanation: Key components (LED driver, LEDs, cap) with their sources, to support the series/model grouping.

items.name: Importer: Authorised Indian Representative (AIR) appointment and undertaking
items.explanation: A foreign manufacturer registers through an AIR resident in India who takes legal responsibility.
